fusions.name: Dismounting Rake
fusions.desc: A swipe that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 3% per 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +30%). You hold 4 charges and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Unflagging Cuffs
fusions.desc: A quick cuff that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mile After Mile
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Gait
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.
